name: What are the benefits of universal design in an accessible kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of universal design in an accessible kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Universal design principles in an accessible kitchen remodel create a space that is usable by people of all ages and abilities, not just those with specific limitations. Benefits include enhanced safety by reducing hazards, increased independence for all users, improved resale value by appealing to a wider demographic, and future-proofing your home as needs change over time. Hometelligent Inc. integrates universal design elements such as varied counter heights and open shelving to ensure long-term functionality and comfort for homes in our service areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Universal design in accessible kitchens enhances safety, promotes independence, increases home value, and future-proofs the space.
